html:
Every year, on October 24th, the world celebrates World Development Information Day. This day was established by the United Nations and is about raising awareness of global issues, particularly regarding sustainable development around the world. This includes the use of technology, communication tools and the digital divide that persists amongst the countries of the world today. Recently, there’s been a big focus on how World Development Information Day technology, like the internet, is helping us spread the word. It’s not just sharing information; technology also plays a key role in making development happen by connecting people and resources, making the world a better place for everyone. Our company, Broadstreet.net is doing amazing things in this field. Let's learn more about this important day and the contributions of Broadstreet.

Broadstreet is a digital marketing company that has a clear goal: to help you connect with the people you want to reach. In addition to Broadstreet’s commitment to the community. There are projects that Broadstreet is affiliated with such as 1) an active Rotary membership which has been committed to supporting the eradication of polio in the world for more than 50 years and promoting clean water, 2) work with KC Trails which is engaged in building resilience in families through nature and outdoor activities, 3) Support for the Jackson Teen Center and "Make it a conversation" that is responsible for making peaceful communities by facilitating conversations between police officers and young people in the communities that they serve, and 4) the ongoing support of Friends of the Edisto, the group overseeing the Edisto River, which is the longest free-flowing blackwater river in North America and a critical natural resource for humans and wildlife.

At Broadstreet we are using social media and creative website design to help people access information about sustainable efforts within the community. With smart social media plans, we make sure your message goes to the intended audience, making a real impact. Our website designs are appealing, practical and user-friendly, creating an immersive experience for visitors. Broadstreet doesn’t stop there; we blend social media, website design, and the latest marketing techniques to make sure your message gets to your audience and keeps them interested. Making a strong impression and encouraging meaningful interactions, we’re your go-to partners in the digital world.

On World Development Information Day, we celebrate the power of information and salute companies that use technology for good. We help businesses increase their visibility. Because of companies like ours, more people can access businesses that provide the goods and services they need. As we learn about these efforts, we also become a part of this positive change. We are inspired to use our knowledge to make the world a better place too!
